about_short_description.short_description: PayLater is an innovative payment provider offering Buy Now, Pay Later solutions to customers in Qatar.

product.name: Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) Service
product.description: A payment solution allowing customers in Qatar to split purchases into four interest-free installments over three months.

product.name: Merchant Payment Solutions
product.description: A service enabling merchants to accept PayLater payments seamlessly online, in-store, and offline with quick settlements and no risk of non-payment.

product.name: PayLater Mobile Application
product.description: A mobile app for customers to sign up, verify identity, track purchases, and manage installment payments securely.

identifier.value: Payment Link Generation for Offline Transactions

product.name: Payment Link Generation for Offline Transactions
product.description: A feature allowing merchants to create and send PayLater payment links to customers via email or messaging platforms for remote payment.
